checkedAlternates.risk: A helical screw both rotates and translates.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Because pitch couples rotation and translation, a helical joint has only 1 independent degree of freedom (group-3), unlike a cylindrical joint (2 DOF, group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Ball joints provide multi-axis wrist motion like universal joints.
checkedAlternates.resolution: A spherical joint allows 3 rotational DOFs (group-1), whereas a universal joint allows 2 (group-2).
